author: harness amendment (user-approved, protocol unchanged)
scope: extractors/c_extractor.py transport layer + continuity/runner.py failure path
summary: C seed=2 cell was missing because a single 503 from the extractor LLM endpoint crashed run between session 1 and session 2, before any ledger row could be written. Amendment adds bounded transport retry (max 3 attempts) around the C extractor's LLM call for transient failures (HTTP 5xx, timeout, connection, overload) only. Parse failures (ExtractionError) are still NOT retried. Retry telemetry (attempts, transport_retries, final error) is recorded per extraction and flows into run metadata. If all retries fail, the run terminates cleanly with infrastructure_failure=true in the ledger rather than an unhandled exception. Extractor model, prompt, temperature, top_p, max output tokens, C schema, serializer, and all task wording are UNCHANGED.

Phase 3 C definition: structured state + SAME frozen Nemotron extractor + bounded parse/schema recovery. Retry allowed only for transport error, malformed JSON, or schema-invalid output (max 3 attempts). Semantic omissions are NEVER retried. Telemetry (attempts, parse success, schema validity) recorded per extraction. C schema/prompt/serializer/serializer-order/model/benchmarks unchanged.

author: correction of AMD-003 (misdiagnosis)
summary: AMD-003 claimed the NIM endpoint dropped the openai/ prefix. That diagnosis was wrong: it was based on raw OpenAI-client probes, which send the model string verbatim (so a prefixed name always 404s in such probes regardless of endpoint health). The SDK dispatches via litellm, which STRIPS the openai/ prefix and routes as custom_llm_provider=openai; the endpoint receives the bare name. The bare 'meta/...' string instead makes litellm route to its built-in Meta provider (MetaException 404) - the actual cause of the Phase 4 pilot failures. Correct operating string: 'openai/meta/muse-glimmer-30b'. All Stage 3 results used this form. Residual lesson: probe the endpoint through the same call path the harness uses (litellm), not a different client.

Fail-closed provider classification (the Phase 4 pilot lesson): cells whose S1/S2 agent error is a provider failure (404/timeout/auth/503/429) are marked INFRA_FAILURE_PROVIDER, do NOT receive a ledger row (so they cannot enter any scientific denominator and are not counted as condition failures), and are re-queued by the launcher up to 3 times before being written as permanently excluded infra rows. Exit codes: 0=success, 1=valid task failure (endpoint worked, agent failed), 3=provider failure. No changes to C schema/prompt/serializer, B, benchmarks, agent model, budgets, or evaluation.
